units: pixels at PPU 16; origin top-left, y grows downward (Unity: worldY = -y/16)
notes: Palette: Abandoned/Ground and Abandoned/Trees are recoloured (grey-blue grass, desaturated trees); vignette stronger (edge alpha 0.68).
Mist over the whole map: Mist_Blob x6, scale 3-5, alpha 0.16, drifting.

Layout: centre clearing with the sacred tree (boss + 3 orbiting riders), a wobbling ring road (paths[1]) with 3 spokes to the centre, and 6 branches (paths[5..10]) to training grounds 1-6; a Signpost where each branch leaves the ring.
Resources: SpiritFlower (Hoa linh) + Sap (Nhựa cây), both in the demo now.
Dryad Riders orbit the sacred tree on an ellipse rx170 ry112 at ~34px/s (see mobs[].orbit).
Rings per the layout spec: Satyr outer, Dryad middle, Dryad Rider orbit around the tree.
